rationale:
The requirement's only obligation is that the submission tool's MCP description is the text "Finish by submitting your structured result in result. Exactly one accepted submission ends this call."

- `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tools.rs#fn[submission_tool]` builds the `submit_result` `ToolDefinition`. It passes that string, character for character, as the description.
- `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent.rs#fn[converse]` calls `tools::submission_tool` when the submit tool is `submit_result`. It passes the result to `session.tools(tool)`.
- `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tools.rs#impl[GraphSession<'_, '_, D>/Conversation]/fn[tools]` adds that definition to the advertised tool list with `tools.extend(submission)`. The description therefore reaches the model unchanged.

I found no conflicting or missing structural element. The `fn[tools]` markers also cover the other fixed tools, and I did not assess those.

No acknowledgments exist.

One observation, which I did not count as a gap: no test asserts the description string. The sibling requirement `submission.mcp` has tests, but my search for the description text found it only in `submission_tool`. This assessment is scoped to structural obligations, and the requirement is a literal string.
